title: Steven Universe
overview: A young boy takes his mother's place in a group of gemstone-based beings, and must learn to control his powers.

episodes.name: Gem Glow
episodes.overview: Steven gets depressed when his favorite ice-cream sandwich brand, Cookie Cat, has been taken off the market. He soon cheers up when the Gems manage to get a hold of some of the last remaining Cookie Cats, which Steven believes may hold the key to activating his gem.
episodes.plot: Steven is disappointed that his favorite ice-cream sandwich brand, Cookie Cat, gets taken off the market. He soon cheers up upon discovering that the Gems managed to get hold of some of the last remaining Cookie Cats, which he comes to believe may be the key to activating his gem.

episodes.name: Laser Light Cannon
episodes.overview: When a menacing red eye is about to hit Beach City, the only thing that can destroy it is a Laser Light Cannon which once belonged to Steven's mother, Rose Quartz. Thus, Steven enlists the help of his father, Greg, and they search through his storage for the cannon.
episodes.plot: When a menacing "Red Eye" is about to hit Beach City, the only thing that can destroy it is a Laser Light Cannon that once belonged to Steven's mother, Rose Quartz. Steven and his father, Greg, search through Greg's storage for the cannon.

episodes.name: Cheeseburger Backpack
episodes.overview: The Gems go on a mission to place a Moon Goddess statue on top of the ruined Lunar Sea Spire, and Steven tries to prove he can be useful with the help of his new novelty cheeseburger backpack.
episodes.plot: The Crystal Gems take Steven on his first mission: to place a Moon Goddess statue on top of the ruined Lunar Sea Spire. Steven tries to prove he can be useful with the help of his new novelty Cheeseburger Backpack.

episodes.name: Together Breakfast
episodes.overview: Steven's attempt to get the Gems to share his special breakfast tradition lands him on a journey through their ancient Gem temple.
episodes.plot: Steven's attempt to get the Gems to share his special breakfast sends him on a journey through their ancient Crystal Temple; but when the breakfast absorbs a dangerous artifact, it comes to life and must be defeated.

episodes.name: Frybo
episodes.overview: Steven brings a mascot costume to life with a magic shard owned by Pearl to help his friend Peedee with his job, but it backfires when the mascot goes rogue.
episodes.plot: Steven brings a mascot costume to life with a magical gem shard in order to help his friend Peedee, but it backfires when the mascot goes rogue.

episodes.name: Cat Fingers
episodes.overview: Steven tries to master his shapeshifting abilities from Amethyst, but turns his fingers into cats, making it harder to do things.
episodes.plot: Trying to master his shapeshifting abilities, Steven turns his fingers into cats, which get out of control.

episodes.name: Bubble Buddies
episodes.overview: Steven creates a magic bubble around himself and a girl he likes, Connie, to save her from a falling rock, but has no idea how to make it disappear.
episodes.plot: Steven forms a magic bubble around himself and a girl named Connie to save her from a falling rock, but he has no idea how to make it disappear.

episodes.name: Serious Steven
episodes.overview: While navigating out of an ancient Gem maze, Steven tries to prove himself worthy to Garnet by being serious.
episodes.plot: While navigating through an ancient Gem maze, Steven tries to prove to the Gems that he can take the mission seriously.

episodes.name: Tiger Millionaire
episodes.overview: Steven joins an underground wrestling league with Amethyst, who is tired of Pearl and Garnet bringing her down.
episodes.plot: Steven joins an underground wrestling league with Amethyst, who's tired of Garnet and Pearl bringing her down.

episodes.name: Steven's Lion
episodes.overview: Steven befriends a magical lion he finds in the desert during a mission with the Gems.

episodes.name: Arcade Mania
episodes.overview: Steven takes the Gems on his own kind of adventure by bringing them to the Fun Land Arcade, where Garnet soon becomes enchanted by a dancing game.
episodes.plot: Steven takes the Gems to the Funland Arcade, where Garnet becomes enchanted by a rhythm game.

episodes.name: Giant Woman
episodes.overview: Steven urges Amethyst and Pearl to fuse together into a four-armed "giant woman" named Opal (Aimee Mann). Amethyst and Pearl, however, keep on quarrelling.
episodes.plot: Steven encourages Amethyst and Pearl to fuse together into a four-armed "giant woman" named Opal, but Amethyst and Pearl keep quarrelling.

episodes.name: So Many Birthdays
episodes.overview: After learning that the Gems are thousands of years old, Steven decides to make up for all the birthdays they've missed.
episodes.plot: After learning that the Gems are thousands of years old, Steven throws a party to make up for all the birthdays they've missed, and he begins to worry about what it means to grow up himself.

episodes.name: Lars and the Cool Kids
episodes.overview: Steven and Lars get to hang out with the cool kids (Jenny Pizza, Buck Dewey and Sour Cream) in town, but their teenage shenanigans get them into magical trouble.
episodes.plot: Steven and Lars hang out with the cool kids—Jenny Pizza, Buck Dewey, and Sour Cream—but their teenage shenanigans get them into magical trouble.

episodes.name: Onion Trade
episodes.overview: A toy trade between Steven and Onion escalates into epic proportions.

episodes.name: Steven the Sword Fighter
episodes.overview: Pearl gets injured and retreats into her gem to heal and make a new body to project after she tries to teach Steven the art of sword-fighting using a holographic version of herself.
episodes.plot: Pearl's attempt to teach Steven the art of sword-fighting using a holographic version of herself goes awry when she gets injured and has to retreat into her gem to heal.

episodes.name: Lion 2: The Movie
episodes.overview: Steven and Connie try to ride Lion to the movie theater, but Lion has other plans.
episodes.plot: Steven and Connie try to ride Lion to the movie theater, but Lion instead takes them to a mysterious Gem armory.

episodes.name: Beach Party
episodes.overview: After a battle damages the Fish Stew Pizza sign, the Gems are banned from the restaurant, so Steven throws a cookout on the beachside to mend the relationship between the Pizza family and the Gems.
episodes.plot: After a battle damages the Fish Stew Pizza sign, the Gems are banned from the restaurant, so Steven throws a cookout on the beachside to mend the relationship between the Pizza family and the Gems.

episodes.name: Rose's Room
episodes.overview: Steven's desire for some alone time unlocks a new room in the Temple that answers his every wish.
episodes.plot: Steven's desire for some alone time unlocks a room in the temple that answers his every wish.

episodes.name: Coach Steven
episodes.overview: Against Pearl's wishes, Steven becomes determined to get stronger after watching Garnet and Amethyst fuse into the mighty Sugilite.
episodes.plot: Against Pearl's advice, Steven becomes determined to get stronger after watching Garnet and Amethyst fuse into the mighty (and destructive) Sugilite.

episodes.name: Joking Victim
episodes.overview: Steven works at the Big Donut when Lars leaves Sadie with all the work.
episodes.plot: When Lars fakes an injury to take a sick day from work, Steven helps Sadie out at the Big Donut, and they pull a prank on Lars to get back at him.

episodes.name: Steven and the Stevens
episodes.overview: Steven needs a musical partner for an upcoming show, so he uses a time travel device to recruit himself as the perfect bandmate.
episodes.plot: Steven needs a musical partner for an upcoming show, so he uses a time travel device to recruit himself as the perfect bandmate. This episode re-uses the time-travel device from the non-canonical pilot episode.

episodes.name: Monster Buddies
episodes.overview: Steven attempts to tame a monster's wild form when he accidentally releases it from its gem bubble.
episodes.plot: Steven accidentally releases a captured Gem monster from her bubble and attempts to tame her wild form.

episodes.name: An Indirect Kiss
episodes.overview: Steven tells Connie about his mission with the Gems to heal Amethyst after she cracks her gemstone.
episodes.plot: Steven tells Connie about his mission with the Gems to heal Amethyst when she cracked her gem.

episodes.name: Mirror Gem
episodes.overview: Steven befriends a magical mirror that can mysteriously communicate with only him and ends up setting free its trapped inhabitant, a Gem named Lapis Lazuli.
episodes.plot: Steven befriends a magical mirror that can mysteriously communicate with him, and ends up freeing its prisoner: Lapis Lazuli, another mysterious Gem.

episodes.name: Ocean Gem
episodes.overview: Lapis Lazuli disappears after reigniting a past conflict with Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl, and takes the ocean along with her, leaving Beach City in a panic on the first day of summer. Steven, Connie, Greg, Lion and the Gems go on a mission to confront Lapis and set things back to normal.
episodes.plot: Lapis Lazuli disappears after reigniting a past conflict with the three Crystal Gems and takes the ocean with her, leaving Beach City in a panic on the first day of summer. Steven, Connie, Greg, Lion and the Gems go on a mission to confront Lapis and set things right.

episodes.name: House Guest
episodes.overview: Left homeless and with a broken leg after the events of the previous episode, Greg stays with Steven and the Gems as a temporary house guest and unintentionally interferes with Steven's healing powers.
episodes.plot: Left temporarily homeless and with a broken leg after the events of the previous episode, Greg stays in Steven's house while his leg heals and unintentionally interferes with Steven's healing powers.

episodes.name: Space Race
episodes.overview: Steven, Pearl and Greg work together to build a spaceship so that Pearl can revisit the wonders of the cosmos, but Pearl gets a little carried away.
episodes.plot: Steven, Pearl, and Greg visit Greg's family's barn and work together to build a spaceship so that Pearl can revisit the wonders of the cosmos, but Pearl gets a little carried away.

episodes.name: Secret Team
episodes.overview: After they accidentally pop a bubble containing gem shards, Steven, Amethyst and Pearl form a secret team to retrieve the shards before Garnet finds out.
episodes.plot: When they accidentally pop a bubble containing gem shards, Steven forms a secret team with Amethyst and Pearl to retrieve the shards before Garnet finds out. After doing so, Steven wants to keep the secret team going.

episodes.name: Island Adventure
episodes.overview: Steven tries to mend Lars' and Sadie's friendship by taking them on vacation to a magical beach.
episodes.plot: Steven tries to mend Lars and Sadie's friendship by taking them on vacation to the mysterious Mask Island; but they become stranded there for several days.

episodes.name: Keep Beach City Weird!
episodes.overview: Steven is taken in by Ronaldo's conspiracy theories about paranormal occurrences in Beach City.
episodes.plot: Steven is taken in by Ronaldo's conspiracy theories about the paranormal occurrences in Beach City.

episodes.name: Fusion Cuisine
episodes.overview: Steven asks the Gems to fuse together and pretend to be his mother at dinner with Connie's family.
episodes.plot: Steven asks the Gems to fuse together into Alexandrite and pretend to be his mother at a dinner with Connie's family.

episodes.name: Garnet's Universe
episodes.overview: Steven interprets what Garnet did during the day after a recent mission.
episodes.plot: When Garnet returns from a mission, Steven imagines a story about what she did all day.

episodes.name: Watermelon Steven
episodes.overview: Steven grows a patch of watermelons shaped like himself, but they soon come to life and attack people.
episodes.plot: Steven grows a patch of watermelons shaped like himself, but they soon come to life and attack the people of Beach City and the Crystal Gems.

episodes.name: Lion 3: Straight to Video
episodes.overview: Lion keeps lying on Steven's face while he's sleeping. This leads to Steven discovering a pocket dimension in Lion's mane.
episodes.plot: Lion keeps lying on Steven's face while he's sleeping, leading Steven to discover a pocket dimension in Lion's mane.This episode was nominated for an Emmy Award for Outstanding Short-Form Animation.

episodes.name: Warp Tour
episodes.overview: Steven becomes uneasy after seeing an unknown object traversing through a warp stream, despite the Gems' attempts to disprove his claims.
episodes.plot: While practicing how to fuse with the Gems, Steven accidentally fuses with Connie, forming an unprecedented Gem/human fusion named Stevonnie.

episodes.name: Alone Together
episodes.overview: While practicing how to fuse with Gems, Steven accidentally fuses with Connie, forming a half-human and half-Gem, human fusion called Stevonnie.
episodes.plot: Steven becomes uneasy after seeing an unknown object traversing a warp stream, despite the Gems' attempts to disprove his claims. They learn that the source of the mysterious objects is Peridot, a Gem from the Gem Homeworld checking up on Earth.

episodes.name: The Test
episodes.overview: Steven finds out that the Lunar Sea Spire mission from the third episode was a test and demands a new one.
episodes.plot: Steven finds out that the Lunar Sea Spire mission from the third episode was meant to be a test of his ability to join the Gems on missions, so he demands a new test.

episodes.name: Future Vision
episodes.overview: Steven learns that Garnet can see into the future and becomes paranoid about the possible dangers around him.
episodes.plot: Steven learns that Garnet can see into the future and becomes paranoid about the possible dangers around him.

episodes.name: On the Run
episodes.overview: Steven and Amethyst try life out on the road. During so, Amethyst reveals a dark secret about herself and the Gems to Steven.
episodes.plot: Steven and Amethyst try out life on the road, and Amethyst reveals her origin to Steven: she was created on Earth as part of the original Gem colonization of the planet.

episodes.name: Horror Club
episodes.overview: Steven goes to the lighthouse to watch scary movies with Ronaldo, Lars and Sadie.
episodes.plot: Steven goes to the lighthouse to watch scary movies with Ronaldo, Lars, and Sadie.

episodes.name: Winter Forecast
episodes.overview: Steven has to take Connie back to her home before a blizzard hits Beach City, and Garnet shows him some outcomes before they leave.
episodes.plot: Steven has to take Connie back to her home before a blizzard hits Beach City, and Garnet shows him some future outcomes of this before they leave.

episodes.name: Maximum Capacity
episodes.overview: While cleaning out Greg's storage unit, Greg and Amethyst are reunited with their favorite sitcom Li'l Butler.
episodes.plot: While cleaning out Greg's storage unit, he and Amethyst are distracted by watching old episodes of their favorite sitcom Li'l Butler.

episodes.name: Marble Madness
episodes.overview: When several droids from space descend towards warp pad zones, Steven and the Gems attempt to track down their purposes.
episodes.plot: When droids from space descend towards warp pad zones, Steven and the Gems attempt to find out their purpose.

episodes.name: Rose's Scabbard
episodes.overview: Pearl takes Steven to a special place that belonged to Rose Quartz after Lion finds the scabbard for Rose's sword.
episodes.plot: Pearl takes Steven to a special place that belonged to Rose Quartz after Lion finds the scabbard for Rose's sword.

episodes.name: The Message
episodes.overview: Steven and the Gems need Greg's help to retrieve a message from the Wailing Stone.
episodes.plot: When Connie is upset by the ending of her favorite book series, Steven takes her to Rose's room to attempt to remake the ending.

episodes.name: Political Power
episodes.overview: The Gems cause a power outage in Beach City, and Steven helps Mayor Dewey with damage control.
episodes.plot: Steven and Buck make T-shirts featuring Steven's crudely drawn advertisement for Greg's guitar lessons.

episodes.name: The Return
episodes.overview: Peridot and her new partner, Jasper, arrive on Earth.
episodes.plot: In this non-canon crossover episode, Uncle Grandpa arrives to aid Steven in unlocking the power of his gem. Notes: The events of the crossover specials take place during the second season of Uncle Grandpa.

episodes.name: Jail Break
episodes.overview: Trapped on Peridot's ship, Steven attempts to rescue the Gems from the Homeworld's clutches, including two Gems named Ruby and Sapphire.

episodes.name: Full Disclosure
episodes.overview: Steven tries to avoid Connie so he won't have to tell her about his ordeal with the Homeworld Gems from the previous episodes.
episodes.plot: Steven tries to avoid Connie so he doesn't have to tell her about his ordeal with the Homeworld Gems from the previous episodes.

episodes.name: Open Book
episodes.overview: When Connie is upset by the ending of her favorite book series, Steven takes her to Rose Quartz's room, where they remake the ending.
episodes.plot: The cool kids take Steven out on a late-night joyride to lift his spirits, and end up discovering Peridot's escape pod.

episodes.name: Joy Ride
episodes.overview: Buck, Jenny and Sour Cream take Steven out on a late-night joyride to lift his spirits and teach him how to have fun, until they end up discovering Peridot's escape pod.
episodes.plot: When Jamie the mailman falls in love with Garnet, Steven and Connie must help turn him down gently.

episodes.name: Say Uncle
episodes.overview: In this non-canon episode, Uncle Grandpa arrives to aid Steven in unlocking the power of his gem.
episodes.plot: Amethyst keeps trying to find a new form to regenerate into while she, Steven and Garnet chase after a Gem monster loose in the temple.

episodes.name: Story for Steven
episodes.overview: Greg tells Steven the story of when he first met Rose Quartz.

episodes.name: Shirt Club
episodes.overview: Steven and Buck make T-shirts.
episodes.plot: Ronaldo investigates the Crystal Gems in a web documentary for his "Keep Beach City Weird" blog.

episodes.name: Love Letters
episodes.overview: When Jamie the mailman falls in love with Garnet, Steven and Connie must help turn him down gently.
episodes.plot: While the Crystal Gems chase after Peridot in the Kindergarten, Steven and Garnet discover a dark secret while exploring its inner workings.

episodes.name: Reformed
episodes.overview: Amethyst keeps trying to find a new form to regenerate into while she, Steven and Garnet chase after a monster loose in the Temple.
episodes.plot: After witnessing Steven and Connie fuse again, Greg explains to them how he learned about fusion from his time with Rose Quartz, hoping to pull it off himself in order to grow closer to her.

episodes.name: Sworn to the Sword
episodes.overview: Wanting to protect Steven, Connie takes up swordfighting lessons with Pearl.
episodes.plot: Steven is exhausted from searching the ocean for Jasper and Lapis Lazuli's fusion, Malachite, so Garnet has Pearl and Amethyst stay with him for a slumber party. Steven, discovering that he has the power of astral projection, is rattled by recurring dreams of Lapis.

episodes.name: Rising Tides, Crashing Skies
episodes.overview: Ronaldo investigates the Crystal Gems in a web documentary for his "Keep Beach City Weird" blog.
episodes.plot: When TV broadcasts are disrupted by a video signal emitted by Peridot from the Gem communication tower, Garnet chooses to fuse with Pearl into Sardonyx to destroy it, which dismays Amethyst. As the tower keeps being fixed, however, Steven and Amethyst are shocked to discover who's really behind it.

episodes.name: Keeping it Together
episodes.overview: While the Crystal Gems chase after Peridot in the Kindergarten, Steven and Garnet discover a dark secret while exploring its inner workings.
episodes.plot: While she accompanies Greg and Steven on a road trip to another state and a visit to a motel, Garnet's anger over what Pearl did in the previous episode causes her to split into Ruby and Sapphire.

episodes.name: We Need to Talk
episodes.overview: After witnessing Steven and Connie fuse again, Greg explains to them how he learned about gem fusion from his time with Rose Quartz, hoping to pull it off himself in order to grow closer to her.
episodes.plot: During a visit to Onion's house, Amethyst rekindles her friendship with his mother, Vidalia, while Onion shows Steven around his room.

episodes.name: Chille Tid
episodes.overview: Garnet has Pearl and Amethyst stay with Steven, who is exhausted from searching for Malachite in the ocean with the Gems, for a slumber party. However, Steven is rattled by recurring dreams of Lapis Lazuli.
episodes.plot: Steven is asked by Jamie to participate in a play funded by Mayor Dewey about Beach City's founding, with Pearl stepping in to provide a more historically accurate script.

episodes.name: Cry for Help
episodes.overview: When TV broadcasts are disrupted by a video signal emitted by Peridot from a Gem communication tower, Garnet chooses to fuse with Pearl into Sardonyx to destroy it, which dismays Amethyst. As the tower keeps being fixed, however, Steven and Amethyst are shocked to discover who's really behind it.
episodes.plot: After the recent events, Pearl wants to redeem herself by capturing Peridot, who then traps the Crystal Gems in an old, abandoned Gem spaceship.

episodes.name: Keystone Motel
episodes.overview: While she accompanies Greg and Steven on a road trip to another state and a visit to a motel in that state, Garnet's frustration with what Pearl did in the previous episode causes her to split into Ruby and Sapphire.
episodes.plot: After Connie's mother confiscates Rose's sword, Steven and Connie sneak into the hospital where she works to retrieve it from her.

episodes.name: Onion Friend
episodes.overview: When they visit Onion's house, Amethyst rekindles her friendship with his mother, Vidalia, while he shows Steven around his room.

episodes.name: Historical Friction
episodes.overview: Steven is asked by Jamie to participate in a play funded by Mayor Dewey about Beach City's founding, with Pearl stepping in to provide a more historically accurate script.
episodes.plot: The Crystal Gems finally capture Peridot, but Steven suspects that she has information that the Crystal Gems need to know and attempts to learn what it is, allowing her to live in his bathroom.

episodes.name: Friend Ship
episodes.overview: After the recent events, Pearl wants to redeem herself by capturing Peridot, who traps the Crystal Gems in an old, abandoned Gem spaceship.
episodes.plot: After Steven explains life on Earth to Peridot, and she experiences her first rainstorm, she decides to tell him about her mission: to locate an experimental Gem creation called the Cluster.

episodes.name: Nightmare Hospital
episodes.overview: Steven and Connie must sneak into a hospital to retrieve Rose Quartz's sword from Connie's mother.
episodes.plot: At the barn, when Peridot and Pearl fight over who will lead the construction of a drill that will take the group to the Cluster's location, Steven suggests they build robots and compete with each other.

episodes.name: Sadie's Song
episodes.overview: Steven helps Sadie with an act for the annual Beach City Beach-a-Palooza.
episodes.plot: Peridot gets carried away with Gem gossip and reveals something about Amethyst, unintentionally offending her.

episodes.name: Catch and Release
episodes.overview: The Crystal Gems finally capture Peridot, but Steven suspects that she knows something and lets her live in his bathroom.
episodes.plot: Garnet tells Steven the story of how Ruby and Sapphire first met and joined the Crystal Gems.This episode was nominated for an Emmy Award for Outstanding Short-Form Animation.

episodes.name: When It Rains
episodes.overview: After Steven explains Earth's workings, including rainstorms, to Peridot, she takes Steven to the Kindergarten to tell him more about the Cluster.
episodes.plot: While celebrating his fourteenth birthday with the Gems, Greg, and Connie, Steven takes on a more adult form using his shapeshifting powers. However, this proves harmful to his human body.

episodes.name: Back to the Barn
episodes.overview: The Crystal Gems and Peridot go to the family barn to build a gem drill that can take them to the Cluster's location. However, when Peridot and Pearl fight over who will lead the project, Steven suggests they build robots and compete with each other.
episodes.plot: Steven and the Gems travel to an information archive on the Moon to discover the Cluster's exact location.

episodes.name: Too Far
episodes.overview: Peridot gets carried away with gem gossip, and unintentionally really hurts Amethyst's feelings.
episodes.plot: Steven becomes devastated and mistrustful of Peridot after she steals a communication device from the Moon Base, which she uses to contact her leader, Yellow Diamond.

episodes.name: The Answer
episodes.overview: Garnet finally tells Steven the story of how she came to be a Crystal Gem.
episodes.plot: While Peridot is in turmoil over what she did in the previous episode, Steven listens to her audio diary and learns how she and Garnet learned to get along during their time at the barn, despite their radical differences.

episodes.name: Steven's Birthday
episodes.overview: Steven has a birthday party out at the barn, and decides he has some growing up to do.

episodes.name: It Could've Been Great
episodes.overview: The Gems take a trip to the moon.

episodes.name: Message Received
episodes.overview: Steven has doubts about believing in everyone.

episodes.name: Log Date 7 15 2
episodes.overview: Steven sneaks a listen to a friend’s audio diary.

episodes.name: Super Watermelon Island
episodes.overview: Steven discovers what happened to his sentient watermelons.
episodes.plot: Using his astral projection ability, Steven discovers that the Watermelon Stevens have formed their own civilization on Mask Island. However, when he sees Malachite on the island as well, the Gems head into action to fight Malachite as Alexandrite, with the Watermelon Stevens helping them.

episodes.name: Gem Drill
episodes.overview: Steven travels deep underground.
episodes.plot: With the other Gems stranded on Mask Island and the Cluster beginning to show signs of forming, Steven and Peridot drill deep underground alone in order to stop the Cluster and save Earth.

episodes.name: Same Old World
episodes.overview: Steven and Lapis Lazuli go on an adventure.
episodes.plot: Lapis Lazuli has nowhere left to go after being freed from her fusion with Jasper, so Steven shows her the locations Earth has to offer to find her a new home.

episodes.name: Barn Mates
episodes.overview: Steven helps two friends get along at the barn.
episodes.plot: Steven tries to help Peridot and Lapis Lazuli resolve their past conflicts and get along at the barn.

episodes.name: Hit the Diamond
episodes.overview: When an envoy of Rubies arrive, Steven proposes a game of baseball.
episodes.plot: A dispatch team of five Ruby soldiers arrives from Homeworld in search of the missing Earth mission leader. To protect Peridot, the Crystal Gems (with Garnet splitting into Ruby and Sapphire again) attempt to get rid of the gullible Rubies by challenging them to a game of baseball.

episodes.name: Steven Floats
episodes.overview: Steven discovers he has a new power while seeking a fresh doughnut.
episodes.plot: Upon returning home with the Gems, Steven discovers he has the ability to float in the air. However, after jumping too high, he becomes stuck in the sky; the Gems spend all night attempting to get him back on the ground.

episodes.name: Drop Beat Dad
episodes.overview: Steven helps Sour Cream put on a show.
episodes.plot: Sour Cream's estranged biological father Marty returns to Beach City and aids him in hosting a concert, much to the dismay of his stepdad, Yellowtail.

episodes.name: Mr. Greg
episodes.overview: Steven visits Empire City with Greg and Pearl.
episodes.plot: In this special musical episode, after Greg suddenly comes into a great deal of money, he takes Steven and Pearl on a vacation to Empire City. However, Pearl is having trouble letting go of her resentment of Greg's relationship with Rose Quartz.This episode was nominated for an Emmy Award for Outstanding Short-Form Animation.

episodes.name: Too Short to Ride
episodes.overview: Steven and Amethyst take a trip to Funland but run into trouble when their friend is too short to ride the rollercoasters.
episodes.plot: Steven, Amethyst, and Peridot visit Funland for the day, but Peridot becomes resentful when they use shapeshifting powers as a way to have fun.

episodes.name: The New Lars
episodes.overview: Steven gets a new look into Lars' life.
episodes.plot: Steven attempts to improve Lars' life when he accidentally ends up in Lars's body due to his astral projection ability.

episodes.name: Beach City Drift
episodes.overview: Steven and Connie get into a high-speed car race with their biggest foe.
episodes.plot: When Steven and Connie run into Kevin, an obnoxious teenager who had harassed Stevonnie in an earlier episode, they fuse again to try to humiliate him by beating him in a car race.

episodes.name: Restaurant Wars
episodes.overview: Steven settles a rivalry between restaurant owners.
episodes.plot: When Steven accidentally re-ignites an old feud between restaurant owners Mr. Fryman and Kofi Pizza, it is up to Steven and the restaurant owners' children to try to stop the feud.

episodes.name: Kiki’s Pizza Delivery Service
episodes.overview: Kiki has nightmares and Steven intervenes.
episodes.plot: Kiki has been having nightmares due to being overworked at Fish Stew Pizza when her sister skips work, so Steven helps by using his astral projection to go into Kiki's dreams.

episodes.name: Monster Reunion
episodes.overview: An old friend returns.
episodes.plot: When Steven's healing powers suddenly return, he re-releases the Centipeetle and attempts to heal her. He can't fully cure her corruption, but he learns from her about her history as a Homeworld officer abandoned on Earth at the end of the war.

episodes.name: Alone at Sea
episodes.overview: Steven and Greg take Lapis on a boat trip out to sea and find themselves in dangerous water.
episodes.plot: Steven and Greg take Lapis Lazuli on a boat ride to help her recover from her trauma. However, Jasper follows them and confronts Lapis, seeking to fuse into Malachite again.

episodes.name: Greg the Babysitter
episodes.overview: Greg tells Steven the story of the time he and Rose babysat Sour Cream for Vidalia.
episodes.plot: When Steven asks Greg how he started working at the car wash, Greg tells Steven about a day he and Rose spent babysitting Sour Cream for Vidalia.

episodes.name: Gem Hunt
episodes.overview: Steven, Pearl and Connie go to the Great North to hunt down a corrupted gem.
episodes.plot: Connie goes on her first mission with Steven and Pearl to find a corrupted Gem monster in the Great North, only to find two monsters being targeted by Jasper.

episodes.name: Crack the Whip
episodes.overview: Amethyst looks after Steven and Connie while Pearl and Garnet look for Jasper's whereabouts.
episodes.plot: When Garnet and Pearl return to the Great North to look for Jasper, Amethyst is put in charge of Steven and Connie. They continue their battle training together and try to have a fun day in Beach City, but are interrupted by the reappearance of Jasper.

episodes.name: Steven vs. Amethyst
episodes.overview: Steven And Amethyst compete against each other while training with Pearl.
episodes.plot: Following the events of the previous episode, Amethyst's self-esteem has hit rock bottom. With Steven's rising power, Amethyst begins to suspect that she is now the weakest Gem on the team. This leads Steven and Amethyst to engage in a duel to see who really is the weakest Gem.

episodes.name: Bismuth
episodes.overview: Steven discovers something the Gems thought was lost to the past inside of Lion's mane.
episodes.plot: Bismuth, one of the original Crystal Gems, is accidentally freed by Steven from a bubble inside Lion's mane. She is welcomed back with open arms by Pearl and Garnet, while Amethyst quickly warms up to her company. However, Steven soon notices that Bismuth's outlook on the rebellion is radically different from the other Gems' when she shows eagerness to re-ignite the Gem War with an unethical secret weapon.

episodes.name: Beta
episodes.overview: Steven and Amethyst visit some friends in the country but Amethyst isn't being herself.

episodes.name: Earthlings
episodes.overview: Amethyst tries to exact revenge with a showdown in the Kindergarten.
episodes.plot: With Amethyst obsessing over her loss to Jasper, Steven takes her to visit Peridot and Lapis Lazuli at the barn. Peridot and Lapis show off their attempts at creating art (which they call "meepmorps"). When that fails to cheer Amethyst up, Peridot takes her and Steven to Jasper's birthplace, a heavily rushed and poorly-made Kindergarten, where they discover Jasper is the only perfectly-formed Gem made at that site.

episodes.name: Back to the Moon
episodes.overview: Steven and the Gems revisit the Moon Base.
episodes.plot: Amethyst fights Jasper but cannot get the upper hand until, in a moment of commiseration with Steven, she fuses with him into Smoky Quartz. Jasper's rash decision to retaliate by fusing with a corrupted Gem results in her being corrupted herself.

episodes.name: Bubbled
episodes.overview: Steven gets marooned in his bubble.
episodes.plot: The dispatch team of Rubies has returned to the barn still searching for Jasper. To try to get rid of them once again, Amethyst impersonates Jasper, but things go awry when the Rubies take her and the other Crystal Gems to contact Yellow Diamond at the Moon Base. While there, Steven learns a shocking fact about his mother, Rose Quartz.

episodes.name: Kindergarten Kid
episodes.overview: Steven and Peridot attempt to catch an elusive speedy corrupted Gem monster in the Beta Kindergarten.
episodes.plot: In an episode described as a homage to Warner Bros.' Road Runner cartoons, Steven and Peridot are determined to catch a fast, elusive Gem monster.

episodes.name: Know Your Fusion
episodes.overview: Steven and the Gems examine fusions.
episodes.plot: When Steven and Amethyst introduce Smoky Quartz to Garnet and Pearl, they fuse into Sardonyx and interview Smoky Quartz about what makes them special.

episodes.name: Buddy's Book
episodes.overview: Steven visits the library with Connie and uncovers a long lost book.
episodes.plot: When Connie takes Steven to the Public Library, he discovers an old journal by William Dewey's first mate Buddy, which chronicles his visits to various Gem locations.

episodes.name: Mindful Education
episodes.overview: Steven and Connie learn to focus better.
episodes.plot: Steven and Connie continue their combat training, and practice fighting while fused as Stevonnie. However, when overwhelming guilt from both Steven and Connie over past events gets in their way, Garnet helps them find inner peace.

episodes.name: Future Boy Zoltron
episodes.overview: Steven tells people's fortunes at Funland.
episodes.plot: After accidentally breaking an old fortune-telling machine at Funland, Steven decides to take its place and tell people's futures. While he initially has fun, he eventually meets a mysterious man who seems to only have depressing futures.

episodes.name: Last One Out of Beach City
episodes.overview: Pearl, Steven and Amethyst go to a rock show.
episodes.plot: Pearl offers to go with Steven and Amethyst to a rock show, deciding to get in touch with her rebellious side whilst trying to impress a woman who looks similar to Rose.

episodes.name: Onion Gang
episodes.overview: Steven learns about Onion's secret group of friends.
episodes.plot: Onion brings Steven into the woods to introduce him to his friends and have a fun day.

episodes.name: Gem Harvest
episodes.overview: In this double episode Steven’s autumn visit to the barn brings a new stranger into his life.
episodes.plot: When Steven visits Lapis and Peridot at the barn, they get an unexpected visit from Greg's grumpy cousin Andy. To get to know his uncle and make him feel at home, Steven attempts to host a family dinner with Andy, Greg, and the Gems.

episodes.name: Three Gems and a Baby
episodes.overview: Greg tells Steven about their first winter together

episodes.name: Steven's Dream
episodes.overview: A strange dream prompts Steven to search for answers.
episodes.plot: Greg tells Steven about his first winter as a baby: when Steven was only a few months old, the Gems were still struggling to understand that Rose Quartz had given up her form to allow Steven to be born and wasn't coming back.

episodes.name: Adventures in Light Distortion
episodes.overview: Steven and the Gems take off on a search and recovery mission.
episodes.plot: Steven begins to have a strange dream that causes him to cry, which he quickly realizes is related to Pink Diamond. When he asks the Gems to give him information about Pink Diamond, they refuse to give any, so Steven and Greg travel to Korea to find the truth themselves.

episodes.name: Gem Heist
episodes.overview: The Gems reach a space station that once belonged to Pink Diamond, and sneak in to rescue Greg, but in order to do so, they must play the roles they were made for, so as not to arouse suspicion.
episodes.plot: After Greg is abducted by Blue Diamond, Steven and the Gems rush off into space with the Rubies' ship to rescue him. Faster-than-light travel has unexpected effects on the Gems' bodies, and in Steven's haste, he puts himself and the Gems in danger.

episodes.name: The Zoo
episodes.overview: Steven finds Greg in Pink Diamond's "Human Zoo", and tries to look for a way out. This proves easier said than done as the humans there are guided through a strictly scheduled and regimented life
episodes.plot: The Gems reach a space station that once belonged to Pink Diamond, and sneak in to rescue Greg, but in order to do so, they must play the roles they were made for, so as not to arouse suspicion.

episodes.name: That Will Be All
episodes.overview: While Blue Diamond and Yellow Diamond argue over their diverging ways of coping with Pink Diamond's death, Steven, Greg and the Crystal Gems attempt to escape the space station before they are discovered.
episodes.plot: Steven finds Greg in Pink Diamond's "Human Zoo", and tries to look for a way out. This proves easier said than done as the humans there are guided through a strictly scheduled and regimented life.

episodes.name: The New Crystal Gems
episodes.overview: Connie tells Steven the story of how she, Peridot, and Lapis attempted to take the Crystal Gems' places as the protectors of Beach City while he was in space.
episodes.plot: While Blue Diamond and Yellow Diamond argue over their diverging ways of coping with Pink Diamond's death, Steven, Greg and the Crystal Gems attempt to escape the space station before they are discovered.

episodes.name: Storm in the Room
episodes.overview: Steven uses his room in the temple to create a simulated image of Rose Quartz in order to try to experience what it would be like to know his mother. He ends up confronting her with his troubled feelings about her complex legacy and her choice to create him.
episodes.plot: Connie tells Steven the story of how she, Peridot, and Lapis attempted to take the Crystal Gems' places as the protectors of Beach City while he was in space.

episodes.name: Rocknaldo
episodes.overview: Ronaldo decides to join the Crystal Gems. However, once Steven lets him join the team, Ronaldo's self-centered attitude begins to try Steven's patience.
episodes.plot: Steven uses his room in the temple to create a simulated image of Rose Quartz in order to try to experience what it would be like to know his mother. He ends up confronting her with his troubled feelings about her complex legacy and her choice to create him.

episodes.name: Tiger Philanthropist
episodes.overview: When Amethyst quits wrestling at the abandoned warehouse, Steven continues doing so himself as Tiger Philanthropist. However, Steven soon begins to doubt the point of wrestling when the audience doesn't take to his new persona.
episodes.plot: Ronaldo decides to join the Crystal Gems. However, once Steven lets him join the team, Ronaldo's self-centered attitude begins to try Steven's patience.

episodes.name: Room for Ruby
episodes.overview: "Navy", one of the Rubies who came to Earth to find Jasper, crashes on Earth and is welcomed in by Steven to be a Crystal Gem. However, Lapis Lazuli does not trust Navy's overly optimistic nature, knowing of her previous encounters with her.
episodes.plot: When Amethyst quits wrestling at the abandoned warehouse, Steven continues doing so himself as Tiger Philanthropist. However, Steven soon begins to doubt the point of wrestling when the audience doesn't take to his new persona.

episodes.name: Lion 4: Alternate Ending
episodes.overview: Steven tries to search for secret messages Rose may have left him about his "magical destiny". Lion eventually leads him to a tape—but it's just an alternate version of the message from Rose he's already seen.
episodes.plot: "Navy", one of the Rubies who came to Earth to find Jasper, crashes on Earth and is welcomed in by Steven to be a Crystal Gem. However, Lapis Lazuli does not trust Navy's overly optimistic nature, knowing of Navy's previous encounters with the Crystal Gems.

episodes.name: Doug Out
episodes.overview: Steven and Connie join Connie's father on a stake out.
episodes.plot: Steven tries to search for secret messages Rose may have left him about his "magical destiny". Lion eventually leads him to a tape—but it's just an alternate version of the message from Rose he's already seen.

episodes.name: The Good Lars
episodes.overview: Steven, Lars and Sadie get invited to a party with the Cool Kids.
episodes.plot: Connie's father, Doug, investigates a break-in at Funland. He invites Steven and Connie to join him to stake out the amusement park.

episodes.name: Are You My Dad?
episodes.overview: People disappearing from Beach City, and Steven tries to solve the mystery.
episodes.plot: The Cool Kids invite Steven, Lars and Sadie to a potluck. Steven and Sadie encourage Lars to bake a cake for the party, but Lars is insecure about revealing his baking skills.

episodes.name: I Am My Mom
episodes.overview: Steven struggles to fix his mistakes.
episodes.plot: Lars, Sadie, Onion and Jamie have mysteriously disappeared. While investigating the mystery, Steven comes across an unfamiliar Gem, who keeps asking "Are you my dad?".

episodes.name: Stuck Together
episodes.overview: Steven and Lars are stuck inside Topaz and try to look for a way to escape.
episodes.plot: Steven and Lars, stuck inside Topaz, try to look for a way to escape the Homeworld-bound ship. Their heartfelt conversation commiserating over their plight earns them Topaz's sympathy.

episodes.name: The Trial
episodes.overview: Steven goes to court against Blue and Yellow Diamond to determine his (or rather Rose Quartz's) fate.
episodes.plot: Steven is put on trial before Blue and Yellow Diamond for Rose Quartz's assassination of Pink Diamond. During the trial, Steven's attorney, a Zircon, analyses the evidence and argues that the public account of Pink Diamond's death doesn't make sense, and suggests that the true facts of the case have been covered up.

episodes.name: Off Colors
episodes.overview: After escaping from the Diamonds, Steven and Lars encounter and befriend the "off-colors", a group of "defective" Gems who live in hiding from Gem society. Lars defends them from security robots but is critically injured in the process.
episodes.plot: After escaping from the Diamonds, Steven and Lars encounter and befriend the "off-colors", a group of "defective" Gems who live in hiding from Gem society.

episodes.name: Lars' Head
episodes.overview: After Steven brings Lars back to life with his healing powers, he discovers that Lars now shares the same powers as Lion.
episodes.plot: After Steven brings Lars back to life with his healing powers, he discovers that Lars now shares the same powers as Lion. When Steven realizes that he can use Lars's hair to teleport himself back to Earth (via Lion's mane), he and Lars must make a difficult choice.

episodes.name: Dewey Wins
episodes.overview: Steven helps Mayor Dewey run a difficult campaign.
episodes.plot: Connie becomes upset with Steven following his return from Homeworld and refuses to talk to him. Feeling dejected, he decides to help Bill Dewey with his rather hopeless re-election campaign for mayor against Nanefua Pizza.

episodes.name: Gemcation
episodes.overview: Greg and the Gems take Steven on vacation to help him relax.
episodes.plot: As Steven remains depressed over Connie's silence, Greg and the Gems misinterpret his sadness and take him to a ranch house for a vacation to cheer him up. The vacation just puts Steven more on edge, until he eventually tells Greg what it is he's upset about.

episodes.name: Raising the Barn
episodes.overview: Pumpkin goes missing.
episodes.plot: When Lapis and Peridot learn what happened to Steven on Homeworld, Lapis wants to flee Earth to avoid getting caught up in another Gem war. However, Peridot wants to stay on Earth to protect it and has a hard time trying to tell Lapis how she feels.

episodes.name: Back to the Kindergarten
episodes.overview: Steven, Amethyst, and Peridot try to spruce up the Kindergarten.
episodes.plot: With Peridot upset over Lapis leaving Earth, Steven and Amethyst decide to help her cheer up by attempting to plant flowers at the utterly barren Kindergarten.

episodes.name: Sadie Killer
episodes.overview: Steven and the Cool Kids start a band, but they have trouble finding their sound.
episodes.plot: Steven and the Cool Kids start a band, but they have trouble finding their sound. They decide to recruit Sadie, who writes a dark song about her frustrating job at the Big Donut; but that same job keeps her from actually participating in the band.

episodes.name: Kevin Party
episodes.overview: Kevin is throwing a party, and Steven is invited.
episodes.plot: Kevin is throwing a party, and invites Steven only so he can show up as Stevonnie. Steven doesn't want to go at first, but changes his mind when Kevin reveals that Connie will be there. When they see each other, Kevin decides to help Steven get his "ex" back so they can fuse.

episodes.name: Lars of the Stars
episodes.overview: Lars rises to the occasion.
episodes.plot: Steven and Connie travel through Lion's mane to visit Lars. When they reach the other side, they discover that Lars and the Off-Color Gems have stolen a spaceship from Emerald and are now on the run from their pursuers.

episodes.name: Jungle Moon
episodes.overview: Stevonnie finds themself alone on an adventure.
episodes.plot: Stevonnie crash-lands in a jungle on an alien moon and, unable to contact Lars, must fend for themself. They discover that the moon houses an abandoned Gem base and orbits a former Gem colony, and have a strange dream involving Yellow Diamond and Pink Diamond. Note: This episode was nominated for an Emmy Award for Outstanding Short-Form Animation. Background painter Patrick Bryson won an Emmy for Outstanding Individual Achievement In Animation for his work on this episode.

episodes.name: Your Mother and Mine
episodes.overview: Steven takes Garnet to meet some of his new friends.
episodes.plot: Steven brings Garnet to meet Lars and his off-color crew. The Off-Colors' beliefs about Rose Quartz have been skewed by Homeworld propaganda, so Garnet tells them the history of Rose's rebellion from the Crystal Gems' perspective.

episodes.name: The Big Show
episodes.overview: Steven shoots a documentary that follows a local band as they get their first big break.
episodes.plot: In this documentary-style episode, Steven records the rise of Sadie's new band, Sadie Killer and the Suspects. The band hires Greg as their manager, who hooks them up with producer Sunshine Justice for a performance in Empire City, though Sadie worries about her mother getting in the way.

episodes.name: Pool Hopping
episodes.overview: Garnet and Steven explore the most unlikely timelines in Beach City.
episodes.plot: Garnet spends a day trying to behave unpredictably, attempting to train her future vision to account for the unexpected. When she and Steven eventually discover some homeless kittens, Garnet admits how lost and stressed she feels when she doesn't know what the future holds.

episodes.name: Letters to Lars
episodes.overview: Steven writes about the latest news of Beach City.
episodes.plot: Lars receives a letter from Steven updating him about the current goings-on in Beach City. While the town and its population are changing, the now-former mayor Bill Dewey is having trouble trying to find his place in the new status quo.

episodes.name: Can't Go Back
episodes.overview: Ronaldo spots something mysterious on the moon, and Steven goes to investigate.
episodes.plot: After Ronaldo sees Lapis's barn on the moon, Steven goes up there to try to persuade her to return to Earth. He almost convinces her, but ends up scaring her away after experiencing another dream about Pink Diamond.

episodes.name: A Single Pale Rose
episodes.overview: Steven helps Pearl find her cell phone.
episodes.plot: Steven confronts Pearl about the shattering of Pink Diamond, but she can't answer his questions. But when Pearl asks him to venture inside her gem to retrieve her cell phone, Steven discovers the secret that Pearl swore to keep long ago.

episodes.name: Now We're Only Falling Apart
episodes.overview: Followed by hearing about the revelation, many problems ensue within the crystal gems' relationships.
episodes.plot: After finding out that Rose Quartz was actually Pink Diamond, Garnet unfuses and Sapphire runs off, devastated. To try and calm her down, Steven and Pearl go after her and tell her the story of how Pink Diamond became Rose Quartz.

episodes.name: What's Your Problem?
episodes.overview: Amethyst convinces Steven to take a break after all he's been through.
episodes.plot: With Ruby missing, Steven and Amethyst go looking for her. Steven takes the search seriously while Amethyst goofs off, but her reasons behind it soon become clear.

episodes.name: The Question
episodes.overview: Ruby decides to explore her own life separate from Sapphire, and has a Wild West adventure as a lonesome cowboy with the help of Steven, Amethyst, and Greg.
episodes.plot: Ruby decides to explore her own life separate from Sapphire, and has a Wild West adventure as a lonesome cowboy with the help of Steven, Amethyst, and Greg. Although she has fun, she still misses Sapphire, and she returns to her with an important question to ask.

episodes.name: Made of Honor
episodes.overview: As Ruby and Sapphire plan their wedding, Sapphire wishes that their friends from the war could be there to see it.
episodes.plot: As Ruby and Sapphire plan their wedding, Sapphire wishes that their friends from the war could be there to see it. Steven releases Bismuth, catches her up on everything, and tries to convince her to go to the wedding.

episodes.name: Reunited
episodes.overview: The wedding of Ruby and Sapphire, with the Gems and several Beach City citizens in attendance, goes without a hitch and Garnet reforms.
episodes.plot: The wedding of Ruby and Sapphire, with the Gems and several Beach City citizens in attendance, goes without a hitch and Garnet reforms. However, during the reception, Blue and Yellow Diamond arrive and awaken the Cluster. While the Crystal Gems, with the Cluster's support, fight the Diamonds, Steven tries to get them to listen to the truth about Pink Diamond.This episode was nominated for an Emmy Award for Outstanding Short-Form Animation.

episodes.name: Legs From Here to Homeworld
episodes.overview: Steven tells Blue and Yellow Diamond that their final attack on the Earth corrupted the remaining Gems on the planet, instead of destroying them outright as intended.

episodes.name: Familiar
episodes.overview: White Diamond believes that Steven is Pink Diamond, so Steven tries to fit Pink's part so that way he can get close enough to White to ask her about helping the corrupted gems on Earth.
episodes.plot: Steven tells Blue and Yellow Diamond that their final attack on the Earth corrupted the remaining Gems on the planet, instead of destroying them outright as intended. The three together attempt to cure Centipeetle's corruption, and almost succeed. To try to finish the job and cure all the corrupted Gems, Blue, Yellow, and the Crystal Gems travel to Homeworld to seek White Diamond's help.

episodes.name: Together Alone
episodes.overview: Steven throws a party to bring his family together.
episodes.plot: Steven struggles to adapt to life as a Diamond. With the help of Pearl, Yellow Diamond and Blue Diamond, he hopes to find out more about Pink Diamond to familiarize himself with his new life on Homeworld. Along with that, he tries to find a way to get all four Diamonds together to finally heal the corrupted Gems.

episodes.name: Escapism
episodes.overview: Steven uses his psychic powers to find help.
episodes.plot: Steven and the gang plan a ball for all of Homeworld in order to get all four Diamonds together in one room and possibly discuss curing Gem corruption. Steven is frustrated when White Diamond doesn't show up, and matters go from bad to worse.

episodes.name: Change Your Mind
episodes.overview: Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.
episodes.plot: With Steven and Connie trapped in a prison tower, and the other Crystal Gems on Homeworld poofed, Steven tries using his psychic powers to contact Connie, Lapis, Peridot, and Bismuth for aid. However, he ends up in the body of a Watermelon Steven on Mask Island, and has to find a way to get to them.
